name: Arcane Messenger
body:
You’ve picked up a few magical tricks to aid in communication.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: arcane mark, comprehend languages, and message. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level.
